name: Councillor Abel Wyke
description: Chain of office tucked inside his coat. Smells of pipe smoke and certainty.

visits.greeting: Curator. Councillor Wyke. You'll know the name.

request.text: The Weatherwright's Ledger. The Council needs a reliable forecast for the harvest fair, and I'm told yours is the only copy.

readThoughts.default: Rain on the Oxley road the day of their market. Only theirs.

purpose.1: The fair. Forecasts. Planning, curator. You'd be amazed what a dry Saturday is worth.

knowledge.0: Weather. It says so on the spine.
